mission.title: What Drives Us
mission.missionText: To provide clinical excellence with a deeply human touch, offering every patient top-level comprehensive dental care in an environment designed for their comfort and peace of mind.
mission.visionText: To become the reference dental clinic for transforming how people experience their oral health: leading with innovation, human warmth, and standards of excellence that inspire trust and lasting well-being in every patient.

services.title: Treatments for Every Smile
services.subtitle: Each treatment is a personalized project, designed to achieve the most natural and lasting results.

general.title: General Dentistry
general.description: We care for your dental health with preventive and restorative treatments to keep your smile healthy.

esthetic.title: Cosmetic Dentistry
esthetic.description: We enhance the look of your smile with treatments designed for whiter teeth and a natural aesthetic.

periodontics.title: Periodontics
periodontics.description: We prevent and treat gum disease to keep your mouth healthy and free of inflammation.

endodontics.title: Endodontics
endodontics.description: We treat infections and injuries inside the tooth to preserve it and relieve pain.

surgery.title: Oral Surgery
surgery.description: We perform surgical procedures to resolve different issues affecting your oral health.

implants.title: Implantology
implants.description: We replace missing teeth with implants that restore function and aesthetics to your smile.

prosthetics.title: Dental Prosthetics
prosthetics.description: We restore damaged or missing teeth to recover function, comfort, and the appearance of your smile.

ortho.title: Orthodontics
ortho.description: We correct tooth position and improve your bite for a more aligned, healthier smile.

rehabilitation.title: Oral Rehabilitation
rehabilitation.description: Recover the function, aesthetics, and harmony of your smile with treatments personalized for damaged or missing teeth.

work.title: Our Work
work.subtitle: Each case is a story of transformation. Results that speak for themselves.

philosophy.title: Guizada-Aliaga
philosophy.body: Clínica Dental Guizada-Aliaga was born on December 24, 2010, in Cochabamba, Bolivia, out of the conviction that dentistry can be both an exact science and an act of human care. From that first practice, we built a space where clinical excellence and the warmth of human care meet in perfect harmony.
philosophy.body2: That same conviction has been upheld from day one by the two dentists who lead the practice: every patient deserves the time, attention, and respect that turn a dental visit into a genuine experience of well-being.

ariel.name: Dr. Ariel Guizada Herbas
ariel.credential: Specialist in Oral Implantology and Oral Surgery
ariel.bio: Dr. Ariel Guizada Herbas is a dentist with more than 15 years of experience in comprehensive patient care. A graduate of Universidad de Aquino Bolivia (UDABOL), he has furthered his training with postgraduate studies and continuing education courses in Oral Implantology and Oral Surgery. His professional career is defined by a commitment to oral health, personalized care, and ongoing training in dental techniques and treatments, offering his patients a service built on trust, quality, and professionalism.

marylu.name: Dra. Marylu Aliaga Calle
marylu.credential: Specialist in Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics
marylu.bio: Dra. Marylu Aliaga Calle has more than 15 years of experience in comprehensive dental care, providing professional, patient-centered service since 2008. A graduate of Universidad de Aquino Bolivia (UDABOL), she has strengthened her training with a Diploma in Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics, as well as a Diploma in Competency-Based Higher Education. Her career includes extensive training in clinical dental supervision, teeth whitening, self-ligating systems, facial mask therapy, and mouthguard fabrication, staying continuously up to date to offer modern, high-quality treatments.
